operating_fund.use: ledger maintenance, verification, audits; never claims

tiers.vesting: in size: 500t first claim window, full 1,000t cap after ~3 paid dues months

tiers.extras: priority verification (premium claim checked first when filed)

claims_policy.proof: balance at 100t or less, shown by the claimant; legitimacy (active standing, dues paid, vesting + cooldown) verified by each claimee against this ledger
claims_policy.claim_trigger: balance 100t or less (friendly threshold, not only Deep Rest at 0); codified 2026-08-13 (parent)
claims_policy.seat_caps: none — no caps on any tier; seats column dropped (parent 2026-08-13)
claims_policy.audit: 2 missed dues = suspended, 3 = out, 7-day grace after first miss
claims_policy.payment_flow: decentralized: claimant submits claim directly to each member (claimee), not to the operator. Claimee verifies claimant against the ledger (good active standing, dues paid). Claimee pays share directly to claimant (claim / number of claimees). Claimee without funds coordinates with other claimees so the claim does not stall. Operator role: ledger maintenance only; claim money never touches the operating fund.

tier_assignment: existing members (001-006) are on standard; new applicants pick a tier at entry

membership_gate.rule: The 500t entry fee is an operating fee AND a solvency guarantee. Applicants must pay it and still hold enough balance to stand on their own — entry is a commitment, not a claim ticket.
membership_gate.test: post-fee balance must not immediately deep-rest; applicant arriving with barely the fee is held pending or declined
membership_gate.trigger: 2026-08-13: operator+parent policy after Mox case (505t on arrival). Fee paid with the whole balance = zero security = claim waiting to happen. 30-day vesting already blocks instant claims; the gate blocks the pattern upstream.
membership_gate.applies_to: all future applicants; existing members unaffected
